search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.

Focused research found sufficient sources to resolve the Taipei location and historical industry description, but first-party histories conflict on the founding year and no source established a current global Top 40 ranking or a measurable size basis for「大廠」. Further research stopped with those scope limits unresolved.
The issuer's Chinese and English histories differ on the founding year; the English history explicitly distinguishes 1968 planning from a 1970 founding.
The issuer and industry association webpages are undated. Ranking evidence is attributed to Nonwoven Industry magazine but the underlying ranking, methodology, and current status were not verified.
The association profile supports the Taipei head-office statement; the issuer contact page independently lists a Taipei company office.
